desc.zh: 从直线边界与带符号转弯，推导保留共线树的单调链。
desc.en: Derive a monotone chain that retains every tree on straight fence edges.

complexity: O(n log n) time; O(n) auxiliary space

concepts.name: convex hull boundary
concepts.description: All perimeter trees, including collinear edge trees

concepts.name: signed turn
concepts.description: Integer cross product distinguishes left, straight and right

concepts.name: monotone chain
concepts.description: Repeated strict-right-turn removal in two sorted scans
